_about: Compute used to produce The AI Search Evidence Index, counted from the Claude Code session logs for this project. Tokens are tokens processed by the model, not billed units; most are cached context read again rather than new work. Counted per assistant message that carries a usage record.
_method: Sum of the usage fields on every assistant message in the project's session transcripts, grouped by UTC date. Cache reads are counted because they are tokens the model processed.

study_window._note: Covers the measurement (27-31 August) and the two verification rounds that followed (1-2 September).
